title: 第7章 丰收第8章 李半仙
content_zh:
第二天一早，二狗子就扛着锄头和柴刀，来到蛇口山脚下。
蛇口山上全都是大石头，小石头，细石头……石缝里顽强地生长出一两棵歪歪扭扭的小树。
靠近山脚有一个石洞，形状就像张开的蛇嘴，一股清泉从石洞里流出，在乱石之间倾泻而下，形成一条小溪流。
小溪流旁边，有一条上山的小道。
这条道只有一两尺宽，窄的地方一尺都不到，只能侧着身从石缝之间挤过去。
山高路滑，比他种禾苗的那座山更难以攀爬，磕磕绊绊，好不容易才到了山顶。
从山顶往下看，终于看到一些稍微平整一点的石头窝窝，散布在山顶和山腰各处。
这种石头窝窝四面都是石头，中间有一个坑，能承接些雨水和泥土，当地都称之为石窝子。
其中有一个比较大的石窝子，四面被巨石围绕，中间一块平地，大约有三亩左右，老犟驴开垦的那一亩新田，便在这里。
到这种石头山上来开荒，老犟驴也是个敢想敢干的人，跟他的名字很贴切。
可惜这个老犟驴，废寝忘食，起早贪黑，才干到一小半就死了。
走进这座石窝子，用锄头挖开厚厚的冰雪，露出下面黑色的泥土。
土壤这么肥，难怪会被老犟驴看上。
二狗子先是把一亩地的积雪清理掉，然后洒上稻种，浇上水。
接下来的几天，二狗子每天往返于蛇口山，把柴火，稻草这些家庭财富都搬过来。
同时，那边的禾苗正在逐渐成熟，这回收割之后，将禾茬全部拨出来，一把火烧掉，不留迹迹。
忙了十几天，山顶那边的禾苗全部收割完毕，连野菜都移了过来。
这次收获的稻谷有十几斗，装了满满三大袋子。
二狗子躺在稻谷上，掐着手指计算，如果每天吃一升，这些谷子够自己吃小半年。
而且，蛇口山这边的一亩地，也快要收割了，起码又能收四石稻谷。

只要不大吃大喝，今年一整年的口粮完全够了。
这人有了吃的，就开始产生点其他小心思。
低头瞥见破成碎布条子的半截裤子，到处漏风不说，该遮的地方遮不住，绑好几道绳子都挂不住了。
他想置办一条新裤子。
他还想买一口铁锅，现在没有锅，每天用瓦片炒稻谷，吃得他嗓子冒烟，嘴巴上火，下面便秘。
有时想想，觉得自己还是太矫情，以前吃猪食都没上火，现在有吃有喝，就生出这么多毛病。
人就不能过得太好。
以后长期住在这里，茅草屋也要盖起来，这次要盖大一点。
如果有余财，他还想弄几块木板，铺一张床，睡地上铺很厚的草也冷，还回潮……
二狗子甩了甩头，将脑子里很多不切实际的想法抛开。
才吃了两顿饱饭，就不知道自己是谁了，竟然产生那么多败家想法，居然还想顿顿有肉。
五天后，石窝子里的一亩稻谷成熟收割，收了四石多。
不过，就在他计划去镇上卖粮买裤子的时候，一件事情却让他很为难。
这么多稻谷摆在这里，万一被人偷了怎么办？
就算没人偷，山里的老鼠麻雀也会偷吃不少。
content_en:
Early the next morning, Er Gouzi carried a hoe and a hatchet and came to the foot of Shekou Mountain.
Shekou Mountain is full of big rocks, small rocks, thin rocks... One or two small crooked trees stubbornly grow out of the cracks in the rocks.
There is a stone cave near the foot of the mountain, shaped like an open snake's mouth. A clear spring flows out of the stone cave and pours down among the rocks to form a small stream.
Next to the stream, there is a trail going up the mountain.
This road is only one or two feet wide, and the narrowest part is not even a foot wide. You can only squeeze through the gaps between the stones sideways.
The mountain was high and the road was slippery, making it more difficult to climb than the mountain where he planted the seedlings. After stumbling, he finally reached the top of the mountain.
Looking down from the top of the mountain, I finally saw some slightly flatter stone nests scattered all over the top and mountainside.
This kind of stone nest is surrounded by stones, with a pit in the middle that can absorb some rainwater and soil. It is called Shiwozi by the locals.
There is a relatively large stone nest, surrounded by huge rocks on all sides, with a flat land in the middle, about three acres, where the new acre of land cultivated by the old donkey is located.
Coming to this kind of stone mountain to open up wasteland, Lao Jianlu is also a person who dares to think and do what he wants, so his name is very appropriate.
It's a pity that this old stubborn ass, who forgot about food and sleep, got up early and was greedy at night, died after working only half of it.
Walking into this stone nest, I used a hoe to dig through the thick ice and snow, revealing the black soil underneath.
The soil is so fertile, no wonder it is attracted by the old donkey.
Ergouzi first cleared the snow from an acre of land, then sprinkled rice seeds and watered it.
In the next few days, Ergouzi traveled to and from Shekou Mountain every day, bringing in all the family wealth such as firewood and straw.
At the same time, the seedlings over there are gradually maturing. After this harvest, all the stubble will be pulled out and burned without leaving a trace.
After more than ten days of work, all the seedlings on the top of the mountain were harvested, and even the wild vegetables were moved over.
There were more than a dozen buckets of rice harvested this time, which filled three big bags.
Ergouzi lay on the rice and counted with his fingers. If he ate one liter a day, he would be able to eat enough grain for half a year.
Moreover, the one acre of land on the Shekou Mountain side is about to be harvested, and at least four stones of rice can be harvested.
As long as you don't eat too much, your food rations will be enough for the whole year.
After the man had something to eat, he began to have other thoughts.
I lowered my head and saw half of the trousers that were in tatters. Not only were they leaking air everywhere, they couldn't cover the places they should be covered, and they couldn't be hung up even after being tied with several ropes.
He wants to buy a new pair of trousers.
He also wanted to buy an iron pot, but he didn't have a pot now. He used tiles to fry rice every day, which made his throat smoke, his mouth get angry, and he was constipated.
Sometimes when I think about it, I feel that I am still too pretentious. I didn’t get angry when I ate pig food before, but now I eat and drink it, so I have so many problems.
People can't live too well.
If I live here for a long time in the future, I will also build a thatched house, this time it will be bigger.
If he had extra money, he would also like to get some wooden boards and build a bed. The thick grass on the sleeping floor would be cold and damp...
Ergouzi shook his head and put away many unrealistic thoughts in his mind.
After just two full meals, I no longer know who I am. I have so many profligate thoughts and still want to eat every meal.
Five days later, one acre of rice in Shiwozi was mature and harvested, and the harvest was more than four shi.
However, just when he was planning to go to the town to sell grain and buy pants, something happened that made him very embarrassed.
There is so much rice here, what if someone steals it?
Even if no one steals it, the rats and sparrows in the mountains will eat a lot.
